SUCCESSOR AGENCY MINUTES 02/06/18 - 7PM
SUCCESSOR AGENCY MINUTES 02/06/18 - 7PM
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
FEBRUARY 06, 2018
07:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 110
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
For record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR HOFBAUER, DIRECTORS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND BISHOP
3. CONSENT CALENDAR â€“ PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY: If you wish to comment on any item(s) listed under the Consent Calendar on this agenda, please come forward to the podium and state the item number(s) and your comments. PLEASE NOTE: A three-minute time limit will be imposed on each speaker other than staff members.
4. CONSENT CALENDAR: NOTICE: All matters listed under the Consent Calendar will be enacted by one motion unless an item(s) is pulled by the Board of Directors, in which case the item(s) will be removed from the Calendar and will be considered separately following this portion of the Agenda.
4.1 Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the Successor Agency to the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Palmdaleâ€™s books as of December 31, 2017. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)

4.3 Approve the Minutes from the previous meetings held January 9, 2018 (5pm), and January 9, 2018 (7pm). (Staff Reference: Agency Secretary Smith)
Staff Recommendation: Move to approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under the Consent Calendar. (Vote - Requires a majority to approve.)
SA Item 4.3 Attachment
5. NON-AGENDA ITEMS - PUBLIC COMMENTS: This portion of the Agenda allows an individual the opportunity to address the Agency on any subject regarding Agency business. Under state legislation, no action can be taken on items not specifically referenced on the Agenda. PLEASE NOTE: A three-minute time limit will be imposed on each speaker other than staff members.
6. ADJOURNMENT to March 6, 2018 at 7:00 in the City Hall Council Chamber located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Suite B, Palmdale, California.
Complete packets can be viewed at City Hall, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Suite A, the City Clerk's Office 38300 Sierra Highway, Suite C, Palmdale, California; and the Main Library, located at 700 East Palmdale Boulevard, Palmdale, California. You can also view the Agendas and Staff Reports on our website at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
Thank you for attending your Successor Agency to the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Palmdale meeting. If you have any questions or wish to know more about the City, please call (661) 267-5100, Monday through Thursday, 7:30 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., closed every Friday.
